title: Sign a training contract for each apprentice or trainee
what: Have a training contract signed within 14 days of an apprenticeship or traineeship starting (for registration).

sources.title: Further Education and Training Act 2014 (Qld)
sources.quote: The employer of a person who is to be trained by the employer as an apprentice or trainee must ensure a training contract is signed by the parties within 14 days after the day the apprenticeship or traineeship starts

reach.condition: if it employs an apprentice or trainee
